name: Guilt And Shame
overview: Scripture reveals that guilt and shame, though real experiences, are met with God's abundant mercy and compassion. The Lord is described as gracious and slow to anger, preserving His people with lovingkindness and truth (Psalms 40:11; 103:8). Believers are assured that through God's help they will not be confounded or ashamed, as He removes the reproach of past sins and casts them away completely (Isaiah 50:7; 54:4; Micah 7:19). This hope is grounded in the truth that God sent His Son not to condemn but to save the world, offering forgiveness and restoration to all who trust in Him (John 3:17).
